I need to determine the molecular formula of a compound in a sample. The only tool available is mass spectrometry using ESI (Electrospray Ionization) technique. Mass spectrometry will give me mass-to-charge (m/z) ratios of ions, which can help identify the molecular weight and potentially the molecular formula.

<thought>
The mass spectrometry data shows:
- Base peak at m/z 268.19394878238 (100% intensity)
- Isotope peaks at m/z 269.197 (20.48%), 270.200 (1.99%), etc.

The base peak at m/z 268.194 likely represents [M+H]+ (protonated molecular ion) in ESI positive mode, which is common for ESI-MS. This would mean the molecular weight is approximately 267.194.

Looking at the isotope pattern:
- M+1 peak is about 20.48% of the base peak
- M+2 peak is about 1.99% of the base peak

The M+1 peak intensity of ~20.5% suggests the presence of carbon atoms. Each carbon contributes about 1.1% to M+1 due to 13C natural abundance. So roughly 20.5/1.1 ≈ 18-19 carbons.

For a molecular weight of ~267 with approximately 18-19 carbons (216-228 mass units from carbon), the remaining mass would be from hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, or other elements.

Let me consider common molecular formulas around MW 267:
- C16H21NO3: 275.15 (too high)

- C16H17NO3: 271.12 (close but not exact)
- C17H21NO2: 271.15 (close)

Wait, let me recalculate more carefully. The exact mass is 268.194 for [M+H]+, so the neutral molecule has mass ~267.187.

Trying C16H25NO3:
- C16 = 16 × 12 = 192
- H25 = 25 × 1.008 = 25.2
- N = 14.007
- O3 = 3 × 15.999 = 47.997
- Total = 279.204 (too high)

Let me try C15H25NO3:
- C15 = 180
- H25 = 25.2
- N = 14.007
- O3 = 47.997
- Total = 267.204 ≈ 267.19 (very close!)

Checking the isotope pattern for C15H25NO3:
- 15 carbons would give M+1 of about 15 × 1.1% = 16.5%
- Plus 1 nitrogen contributes 0.37%
- Total M+1 ≈ 16.9% (close to observed 20.5%, but a bit low)

Let me try C16H25NO2:
- C16 = 192
- H25 = 25.2
- N = 14.007
- O2 = 31.998
- Total = 263.205 (too low)

Let me try C17H25NO:
- C17 = 204
- H25 = 25.2
- N = 14.007
- O = 15.999

Back to C15H25NO3 with exact mass calculation:
C15H25NO3 = 15(12.000) + 25(1.00783) + 14.00307 + 3(15.99491) = 180 + 25.196 + 14.003 + 47.985 = 267.184

This is very close to 267.187! The [M+H]+ would be 268.191, matching our observed 268.194.

The molecular formula is C15H25NO3.
